projects.name: Catalyst
projects.tagline: One home for movies and series.
projects.description: A native app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. Discover what to watch, keep your place across devices, and play from the sources you already use.
highlights: Built-in player, or the one you prefer
Your place synced with Trakt and CataSync

projects.name: Hangar
projects.tagline: Every Steam account, one click away.
projects.description: Changes the signed-in Steam account without the account picker or a password prompt, and shows every game on every account.
highlights: Silent switching, straight to the tray
Play as… launches a game on the account that owns it
Your whole library, installed or not

projects.name: Verdant
projects.description: Finds the latest Game Ready and Studio drivers for your NVIDIA card, checks they're genuine and installs them with one prompt.
highlights: Matches your exact card with NVIDIA's catalog
Only runs installers signed by NVIDIA
Express or custom install, with roll back
Live GPU temperature, load and VRAM
